overview: The Marathon County Public Safety Committee convened briefly to vote on entering closed session to discuss negotiation strategy related to the Village of Rib Mountain. The committee approved the closed session motion on a roll call vote with all present members voting yes. No open session business or public comment was recorded in the available transcript.
presiding: Unknown — chair not identified by name in transcript

discussions.item: Motion to Enter Closed Session — Village of Rib Mountain Negotiations
discussions.body: A member identified as Jen made a motion to enter closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes 19.851(e) for the purpose of discussing negotiation strategy related to the Village of Rib Mountain, citing competitive or bargaining reasons. Brandon Johnson provided the second. A roll call vote was conducted; members Mask, Arstad, Hoppa, Johnson, Strobe, and Wilhelm all voted yes. Sandusky was noted as absent. The chair declared the motion carried and the committee proceeded into closed session.
